curvature_method: conservative bias-expanded normal interval; not optimized Kolesar-Rothe
effects: 10cp evaluation bin by stage by period by speed
missing: reject missing or invalid model fields
monthly: separate month/speed models with chooser and eval10-by-stage FE; joint chooser covariance across months
primary_contrast: mu4 minus equal-weight OLS linear extrapolation of mu0..mu3 to 4
primary_inference: chooser clustered CR0; normal 95% intervals; full joint covariance
sample: author-excluded main; finite non-mate cp < -100; deficits 0..8
secondary_inference: chooser + UTC last-move date - chooser/date CR0; no PSD repair
singletons: iteratively remove FE-singleton rows; report retained sample
warning: Calendar windows do not verify deployment; adjusted contrasts do not isolate selection from behavior
